name: Backwards dash-jump: turn away from a wall and dash-jump on one tick
techNote: A floor (top y 0) and a wall (x 300-340) at its right. Walk right into the wall (stopped at x 274.5, the hitbox against its face), then on one tick turn left and press dash and jump together. The dash start's -20 shove puts the dot back into the wall and the buffered jump is a grounded dash jump from there: the super (805 up, 876 momentum left after the tick), out over the floor into the finish box (x -420 to -250, y 250-330) on tick 32. The overlay's BACKWARDS DASH-JUMP needs the wall behind the dash on its start tick and the turn within its flip window.
